name: Apple iPhone 17 256GB
short_desc: The entirely new iPhone 17. Upgraded dual cameras, advanced AI features, and A19 chip.
long_desc: iPhone 17. Step into the future with a radically new design. Super Retina XDR OLED display with ProMotion technology now available on the base model. Powered by the A19 Bionic chip for superior AI processing and unprecedented battery life. The advanced dual-camera system now supports Spatial Video recording for Apple Vision Pro. USB-C 3.0 support and completely redesigned cooling system.

name: Apple iPhone 17 Pro 256GB
short_desc: Pro-grade titanium design. A19 Pro chip. 48MP Triple camera array. True 120Hz.
long_desc: iPhone 17 Pro. The ultimate professional tool. Forged from Aerospace-grade titanium, making it lighter and more durable than ever. Powered by the incredibly fast A19 Pro chip with a 6-core GPU, bringing console-level gaming to mobile. Features a completely overhauled 48MP triple-camera system with a new 5x Telephoto lens across the entire Pro lineup. Action button and USB-C with incredibly fast transfer speeds.

name: Apple AirPods Pro 2
short_desc: Up to 2x more Active Noise Cancellation. Adaptive Transparency. Personalized Spatial Audio.
long_desc: AirPods Pro (2nd generation) with MagSafe Charging Case (USB-C) deliver up to 2x more Active Noise Cancellation than the previous generation, with Adaptive Transparency that filters outside noise in real time. Personalized Spatial Audio with dynamic head tracking places sound all around you. Touch control lets you swipe to adjust volume. And a leap in power delivers 6 hours of battery life from a single charge.

name: Apple AirPods 4
short_desc: Next-generation audio experience. Redesigned for all-day comfort. USB-C charging.
long_desc: AirPods 4 offer an entirely new design optimized for all-day comfort, providing a secure fit and excellent sound quality. Powered by the H2 chip, delivering richer bass, clearer highs, and impressive battery life. The redesigned charging case now supports USB-C for universal compatibility. Enjoy seamless device switching and quick access to Siri.

name: Apple Watch SE 3 40mm
short_desc: Essential Apple Watch features. Fitness tracking, heart rate, and Crash Detection.
long_desc: Apple Watch SE 3rd Generation provides all the essential features you love about Apple Watch at an incredible value. Track your workouts, monitor your heart rate, and stay connected directly from your wrist. Features advanced safety sensors for Fall Detection and Crash Detection. Swimproof design and a Retina display that's up to 20% larger than previous generations.

name: Apple Watch Series 11 41mm
short_desc: The most advanced Apple Watch display. Next-gen health sensors and Sleep Apnea detection.
long_desc: Apple Watch Series 11 represents a monumental leap in smartwatch technology. Featuring the largest, brightest Always-On Retina display ever created. Revolutionary new health sensors allow for accurate body temperature tracking and breakthrough Sleep Apnea detection. Powered by the ultra-fast S11 SiP, ensuring flawless performance. Features fast charging and a durable, crack-resistant front crystal.

name: Apple Watch Ultra 2 GPS + Cellular
short_desc: Rugged titanium case. Precision dual-frequency GPS. Up to 36 hours of battery life.
long_desc: Apple Watch Ultra 2. The most rugged and capable Apple Watch pushes the limits again. Featuring the all-new S9 SiP, a magical new double tap gesture, and our brightest display ever at 3000 nits. The aerospace-grade titanium case balances weight, durability, and corrosion resistance. Precision dual-frequency GPS provides unparalleled accuracy. Designed for extreme environments, elevations, and temperatures.

name: Apple MacBook Air M5 13-inch 2026
short_desc: Incredibly thin. Superfast M5 chip. 18-hour battery life. Liquid Retina display.
long_desc: MacBook Air 13-inch 2026. Redesigned around the groundbreaking M5 chip, the new MacBook Air delivers blazing-fast performance and incredible 18-hour battery life in its strikingly thin aluminum enclosure. The brilliant 13.6-inch Liquid Retina display features 500 nits of brightness, P3 wide color, and True Tone technology. 1080p FaceTime HD camera, four-speaker sound system with Spatial Audio, and MagSafe charging. The perfect ultra-portable laptop for work and play.

name: Apple MacBook Pro 13-inch 2018
short_desc: Intel Core i5. Touch Bar and Touch ID. 8GB RAM. 256GB SSD storage.
long_desc: MacBook Pro 13-inch (2018). Featuring a powerful quad-core Intel Core i5 processor, this reliable MacBook Pro is perfect for students and professionals. Equipped with the innovative Touch Bar and Touch ID for instant access to tools and secure authentication. The brilliant Retina display with True Tone technology makes images look more natural. Dual Thunderbolt 3 (USB-C) ports and a butterfly keyboard.

name: Apple Magic Mouse 3
short_desc: Wireless and rechargeable. Multi-Touch surface. Optimized foot design.
long_desc: Magic Mouse 3 is wireless and rechargeable, featuring an optimized foot design that lets it glide smoothly across your desk. The Multi-Touch surface allows you to perform simple gestures such as swiping between web pages and scrolling through documents. The incredibly long-lasting internal battery will power your Magic Mouse for about a month or more between charges.

name: Apple Magic Mouse 2
short_desc: Rechargeable built-in battery. Multi-Touch support. Sleek, seamless design.
long_desc: Magic Mouse 2 features a completely rechargeable battery, eliminating the need for traditional batteries. It’s lighter, has fewer moving parts thanks to its built-in battery and continuous bottom shell, and has an optimized foot design — all helping Magic Mouse 2 track easier and move with less resistance across your desk. Supports seamless Multi-Touch gestures.

name: Apple Magic Keyboard USB-C Touch ID
short_desc: Integrated Touch ID. Numeric Keypad. USB-C port. Extended layout.
long_desc: Magic Keyboard with Touch ID and Numeric Keypad delivers a remarkably comfortable and precise typing experience. It features an extended layout, with document navigation controls for quick scrolling and full-size arrow keys, which are great for gaming. The numeric keypad is also ideal for spreadsheets and finance applications. Integrated Touch ID provides fast, easy, and secure authentication for logins and purchases. Features the new universal USB-C charging port.

name: Apple iPhone 13 128GB
short_desc: Super Retina XDR display. A15 Bionic chip. Advanced dual-camera system.
long_desc: iPhone 13. Your new superpower. Super Retina XDR display. A15 Bionic chip for lightning-fast performance. Advanced dual-camera system with 12MP Wide and Ultra Wide cameras. Cinematic mode adds shallow depth of field and shifts focus automatically in your videos. Ceramic Shield, tougher than any smartphone glass.

name: Apple iPhone 14 Pro Max 256GB
short_desc: Dynamic Island. 48MP Main camera. Always-On display. A16 Bionic.
long_desc: iPhone 14 Pro Max. Capture incredible detail with a 48MP Main camera. Experience iPhone in a whole new way with Dynamic Island and Always-On display. Crash Detection, a new safety feature, calls for help when you can’t. All powered by the ultimate smartphone chip, A16 Bionic.

short_desc: The all-new iPad Air. More versatile than ever. The stunning 10.9-inch Liquid Retina display with wide color lets you see photos, videos, and games in vivid, true-to-life detail.

long_desc:
Apple Watch Series 6 can notify you if your heart rate is too high or too low, or if it detects an irregular heart rhythm. It also measures your blood oxygen level with a revolutionary new sensor and app. Track your daily activity and accurately record all your favorite workouts. See it all clearly on the Always-On Retina display. And with the cellular model, you can leave your phone behind.

Measure your blood oxygen with an all-new sensor and app. Check your heart rhythm with the ECG app. The Always-On Retina display is 2.5x brighter outdoors when your wrist is down. The S6 SiP is up to 20% faster than Series 5. 5GHz Wi-Fi and U1 Ultra Wideband chip. Track your daily activity on Apple Watch and see your trends in the Fitness app on iPhone. Measure workouts like running, walking, cycling, yoga, swimming, and dance. Swimproof design. Sync your favorite music, podcasts, and audiobooks.
name: Apple Watch Series 6 40mm GPS Sport Band
short_desc: Apple Watch Series 6 can notify you if your heart rate is too high or too low, or if it detects an irregular heart rhythm.

long_desc:
A flawless experience on a large edge-to-edge display.
Apple Watch Series 7 features the largest, most advanced display yet, completely re-engineered to reduce the borders by 40%, allowing for nearly 20% more screen area than Series 6 and over 50% more than Series 3. The Always-On Retina display is brighter indoors when your wrist is down, making it easier to read the watch face and complications. 

The most durable Apple Watch ever built.
The front crystal is 50% thicker and completely redesigned with a robust geometry to make it more crack-resistant. It's also IP6X dust resistant and WR50 water resistant for swimming in the pool or ocean.

Advanced health features.
Measure your blood oxygen level with a revolutionary sensor and app. Take an ECG anytime, anywhere. Receive notifications for high, low, and irregular heart rhythms. Track your sleep to help establish a regular bedtime routine and meet your sleep goals.

Fast charging.
The entire charging system for Apple Watch Series 7 has been rethought to get you up and running faster than ever. With an updated charging architecture and fast-charging USB-C cable, it charges from 0 to 80% in about 45 minutes.
name: Apple Watch Series 7 41mm GPS Sport Band
short_desc: A flawless experience on a large edge-to-edge display. The most durable Apple Watch ever.

long_desc:
Premium design with significant changes compared to previous generations. The stem is shorter and angled for a contoured fit. Spatial audio with dynamic head tracking places sound all around you to create a three-dimensional listening experience for music, TV shows, and movies. Adaptive EQ automatically tunes music to your ears. Force sensor lets you easily control your entertainment, answer or end calls, and more. 

Sweat and water resistant for both the AirPods and the charging case. Up to 6 hours of listening time on one charge. MagSafe Charging Case delivers more than 30 hours of total listening time and supports wireless charging. Quick access to Siri by saying 'Hey Siri'. Effortless setup, in-ear detection, and automatic switching for a magical experience. Easily share audio between two sets of AirPods on your iPhone, iPad, iPod touch, or Apple TV.
